title: After-Hours Work and the Remobilization Fee of Professional Services Projects
content:
Work logged in scheduled after-hours windows on a Professional Services Projects engagement adds to the remobilization fee of a fixed-fee engagement resumed after a long client-caused hold.

400.00 is added to the remobilization fee when after-hours time logged on the engagement totals 960 minutes or more, 200.00 when some but less is logged, and nothing when none is.

| After-hours time logged on the engagement | Added |
|---|---|
| 960 minutes (16 hours) or more | 400.00 |
| more than zero, less than 960 minutes | 200.00 |
| none | nothing |

All after-hours time logged on the engagement counts, whatever the person level. Hypothetical boundary cases: 959 minutes adds 200.00 and 960 minutes adds 400.00.
